budget.rationale: The published budget, unreduced. A sample is one generated equation program and samples_per_prompt is 4, so 10000 samples is about 2500 requests for the one searched target. The pilot measures what that budget costs on the Jetstream2 hosted endpoint, and its sample log shows what the search had found by 200, 1000, 5000 and 10000 samples, before the full Phase C matrix is frozen.

prompt_policy.description: LLM-SR specifications natively embed a problem description, so supplying the public task specification matches its own protocol.

scope_note: Budget pilot: one cell and one seed. The cell is the first in the Phase C roster (Dalla Man T1 easy, one target, Gp), chosen by its position and not by any result. Every other LLM-SR setting is its own default: 10 islands, 4 samples per prompt, a 30-second evaluation timeout and a 4-hour island reset.
